bullets: • Validate CSS selectors for duplicates and conflicts before Hermes submission using linting tools.
• Remove orphaned CSS rules when overriding values; never layer new rules atop outdated declarations.
• Require UTF-8 encoding for changelog entries; validate special characters and emoji support upfront.
• Verify patch target anchors exist in actual files before applying diffs; use semantic markers over exact strings.
• Close all CSS comments properly: use `*/` not incomplete `/*` syntax in HTML style tags.
• Implement pre-submission checklist: changelog entries must exactly match actual code modifications applied.
• Define distinct data sources for each stat metric; prevent duplicate logic assignments to different UI elements.
• Handle missing data with numeric zero `0`, not dashes; explicit edge-case defaults in all stats cards.
